theorems_only_on_branches.name: G1Audit.dynamic_campanato_of_bridge
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {Point : Type*} (d : DynamicCampanatoData Point) (bridge : PDEToDynamicCampanato d) : DynamicCampanatoTarget d

theorems_only_on_branches.name: G1Audit.gamma_half_closes_campanato
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (g : GammaClosure) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hJr : ∀ s : OneStepCampanato, s.gamma = g.gamma → s.A = g.A → s.Jr ≤ C * (s.r / s.rho)) (s : OneStepCampanato) (hsg : s.gamma = g.gamma) (hsA : s.A = g.A) (hclose : 2 * g.gamma * C + 2 * g.A ≤ C) : s.JrHalf ≤ C * ((s.r / 2) / s.rho)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: G1Audit.remainder_integral_from_energy
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (d : CutoffFreeApproximationData) (b : LerayEnergyIntegralBudget d) (u0L2 nu : ℝ) (hnu : 0 < nu) (hEnergy : b.gradIntegral ≤ u0L2 ^ 2 / (2 * nu)) : b.aIntegral ≤ d.Ckappa * (u0L2 ^ 2 / (2 * nu))
